name: Webhook Router
description: Route incoming webhooks by event type to type-specific handlers. Unrouteable payloads (unknown type, missing type, missing required fields) are sent to a dead-letter queue.

metadata.idempotency_notes: Each event is processed exactly once per call. The event_id can be used downstream for idempotent processing (e.g., skip if order_id already processed).
metadata.retry_notes: Dead-lettered events should be logged and periodically retried via a separate replay mechanism. Unknown event types may indicate an integration that needs a new handler registered.
